input: Buy a ukulele and learn three songs

gold.taskTitle: Buy a Ukulele and Learn Three Songs
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a ukulele and become capable of playing three songs on it.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for the ukulele?
questions.description: Understanding the price range will shape whether to look at beginner, mid-range, or premium instruments.

questions.title: What size ukulele are you thinking of getting?
questions.description: Soprano, concert, tenor, and baritone all have different sounds and feels, which affects the purchase decision.

questions.title: Are you buying the ukulele online or in a store?
questions.description: The purchasing channel determines what research, shipping time, or travel logistics are involved.

questions.title: Have you played any stringed instrument before?
questions.description: Prior musical experience affects how quickly the user can learn and what level of instruction they need.

questions.title: Do you already have specific songs you want to learn?
questions.description: Knowing the target songs helps assess difficulty, required chords, and a realistic learning timeline.

questions.title: How do you plan to learn — tutorials, app, or teacher?
questions.description: The learning method shapes the structure of the plan, required resources, and associated costs.

questions.title: By when do you want to play all three songs?
questions.description: A target deadline helps set a realistic practice schedule and milestone checkpoints.
